# Hootsuite Blog

> > The Hootsuite Blog is the definitive resource for social media marketing strategy, platform-specific tactics, and expert insights across all major networks.

Hootsuite Blog provides expert-authored content on social media marketing, management strategies, and platform-specific guidance for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and YouTube. The blog features comprehensive guides, trend reports, analytics benchmarks, and actionable resources for social media professionals and marketers.

## Strategy & Management Guides

- [Social Media Trends 2026](https://blog.hootsuite.com/social-media-trends): 2026 social media trends report covering discovery, trust, and cultural shifts
- [Social Media Management: The 2026 Expert Playbook](https://blog.hootsuite.com/social-media-management): Expert playbook on social media management strategy and team structures
- [Engagement Rate Benchmarks and Formulas: 2026 Update](https://blog.hootsuite.com/calculate-engagement-rate): Guide to engagement rate formulas, benchmarks, and performance optimization
